transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
My right knee's been aching. Worse lately.
When did you first notice the aching in your right knee?
Oh, about three years back it started.
Have you ever had an allergy or a bad reaction to any medicine?
Penicillin gives me a rash.
On a scale from 0 to 10, how bad is the aching in your right knee?
About a 7 on bad days.
What medicines do you take regularly, if any?
My wife's knees bother her too, funnily enough.
Have you ever had an operation for anything?
Had a stent put in a heart artery, six years ago.
Besides the aching, is there anything else you've noticed about your right knee?
It swells a bit by the evening sometimes.
Do you take any medicines regularly, or have you started or changed any recently, or are you not sure?
I take metformin, twice a day.
Does anything make the aching in your right knee better or worse?
Worse going down the stairs.
What worries you most about your right knee?
Wondering if I might need a knee replacement.

Thanks for telling me about the stent in your heart artery. Is there anything else about your past health — like other long-term conditions, illnesses, operations or hospital stays — that you think I should know about?
I've got type 2 diabetes, about ten years now.
Has the aching in your right knee changed how you get around on a typical day?
I go down stairs one step at a time now, holding the rail.
Besides the aching and the swelling in the evening, have you noticed anything else different with your knee?
No redness or fever. And it doesn't lock up.
Anything else about your past health — like other conditions, operations, or hospital stays — that you think I should know?
My brother had a bad hip, but nothing else comes to mind.
Besides the metformin you take twice a day, are there any other medicines you take, including any new or changed ones?
Also aspirin, once a day.
Is there anything else you've noticed about your knee that you haven't already mentioned?
It's stiff for about twenty minutes each morning.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
